title: Schönhauser Allee Berlin - FAQ
subtitle: The viaduct, the stops, the opening hours and the best day to walk it.

items.q: Where does the U2 run above ground on Schönhauser Allee?
items.a: The U2 leaves its tunnel about **500 m** north of **Senefelderplatz** and climbs a ramp in the middle of the street. It then runs on a steel viaduct through **Eberswalder Straße** and **Schönhauser Allee**, roughly **2 km** in all.

items.q: Why is the viaduct called the Magistratsschirm?
items.a: It is a popular nickname meaning the city council's umbrella. The elevated line, opened on **27 July 1913**, was cheaper than a tunnel on the wide street, and you can walk dry underneath it in the rain.

items.q: How long does the walk take?
items.a: About **25 minutes** for the **1.9 km** from Senefelderplatz to Schönhauser Allee without stops. With the cemetery, the Kulturbrauerei and a currywurst, plan **one to two hours**.

items.q: When is the Jewish Cemetery Schönhauser Allee open?
items.a: According to berlin.de, checked on 26 November 2026: **Monday to Thursday 8:00 to 16:00**, **Friday 7:30 to 13:00**, closed on **Saturday, Sunday** and Jewish holidays. Men are asked to cover their heads.
**Tuesday to Friday 11:00 to 18:00** and **Saturday 12:00 to 19:00**, closed on **Sunday and Monday**, according to its own website. It stands under the viaduct by Eberswalder Straße.

items.q: When is the Lucia Christmas market at the Kulturbrauerei?
items.a: From **23 November to 22 December 2026**, **Monday to Friday 15:00 to 22:00** and **weekends 13:00 to 22:00**, with free entry. The Lucia procession is on **Sunday 13 December at 18:00**.

The station is open, but when I checked on **26 November 2026**, trains towards **Pankow** were not stopping there, only trains towards the city. Ride to Eberswalder Straße instead, or check the BVG app on the day.

items.q: Is Schönhauser Allee station affected by building work?
items.a: Yes. BVG closed the **north entrance** of U Schönhauser Allee on **13 November 2026** for bridge works, until about **spring 2027**. The other entrances are open and the U2 runs.

items.q: What is the best day to walk Schönhauser Allee?
items.a: **Tuesday to Friday.** On those days the cemetery, Konnopke's and the Christmas market are all open. On Saturday the cemetery is shut, and on Sunday and Monday Konnopke's is.
